targets.title: Personalized Glucose Targets
targets.subtitle: Clinical target ranges by measurement context and clinician approval status
targets.educationalNotice: General reference ranges are educational information and are not personalized medical targets. Target selection must account for age, diabetes type, medication, hypoglycemia risk, other health conditions, and clinician advice. Personal glucose targets must be confirmed by an attending physician.
targets.caregiverPendingNotice: Targets configured by family caregivers are saved with 'Pending Approval' status. They will not be treated as approved personal targets until reviewed and confirmed by an attending clinician.
targets.clinicianImmediateNotice: You are configuring this target as an authorized clinician. Saving this target will immediately approve and activate it for patient glucose evaluations.
targets.adaGuidelinesTitle: ADA Standards of Care Glycemic Goals
targets.guidelineDisclaimer: General reference ranges are educational information and are not personalized medical targets. Never change prescribed medication doses without consulting your attending healthcare professional.
targets.targetHistorySubtitle: Chronological audit trail of target proposals, updates, and clinician decisions

alerts.hypo1515Title: Educational 15-15 Rule for Conscious Low Blood Sugar
alerts.hypo1515Step1: Take 15 grams of fast-acting sugar immediately (e.g. 1/2 cup fruit juice or 3-4 candies).
alerts.hypo1515Step3: Re-test blood sugar. If still below 70 mg/dL, repeat with another 15g.
alerts.unconsciousWarning: ⚠️ If unconscious or unable to swallow: DO NOT give food or liquids by mouth! Call emergency medical services (119 / hospital) immediately!
